Every reduced fixed component is an entire closed-fiber component and has generic whole-fiber multiplicity at least two. This does not bound its fixed-scheme thickness.

At a generically rank-zero component of the quotient differential, mu>=4; both Ai residues are constants and A/q=C[cbar]. Ambient cotangent rank is essential.

In degree two, a generic-rank-zero component consumes all four units of total multiplicity and forces whole-fiber irreducibility. Retained topology then forces multiplicity two, a contradiction. Such components do not exist; isolated rank drops and rank-one fixed curves are not excluded.

In degree three, at most one generically rank-zero component occurs. Its necessary profiles are mu6 alone with retained branch degrees2,3; mu5 with one multiplicity-one component; or mu4 with remaining total multiplicity1 or2. These profiles are not realizations.

If both Ai collapse, the tensor pencil makes hbar constant. Its cylinder is an actual affine plane qB=(X,Y), for affine-linear original good coordinates. E and original partial_z preserve it; their commutator vanishes on its quotient.
At generic quotient rank zero, mB lies in (X,Y)^2 and the original velocity Jacobian has rank exactly one at every point of this plane, with square zero there.
